title: Section 6a: a failed gate on any carried tree ends adoption of that round for every later carry
outcome: Section 6a: a failed gate on any carried tree ends adoption of that round for every later carry
acceptance: /review-changes section 6a says that a failed gate or check on a carried tree ends adoption of that review round for that carry and every later one, so only a new round can be carried further
The change is recorded as a narrowing under the authority-text procedure (a), (b) and (c), and TermAl's twin rule, if it exists by then, gets the same narrowing or a recorded reason why not
